item: Nothing writes into or remakes the folder an erase started on (R802, row 343)
summary: The erase latches its data folder for the rest of the process: data_dir refuses it, an audit hook refuses writes, mkdir, rename and links into it, the error journal writes to stderr when its folder is gone, removed is measured after the last log line and a folder that came back reads may be incomplete (x12); secure uninstall latches at scheduling and its watcher checks the folder after the wipe; requests after a wipe get a 503; the scrub never remakes the folder.
